tests.description: DW53-E2E-001: original transport error identity/diagnostics survive real service wrapping, the real store/UI retain unsaved fields, and explicit real HTTP retry succeeds.

contract: Install after navigation/hydration. Dynamically import the real browser events service and Supabase client using Vite module URLs.
Create original TypeError via browser realm factory with message socket closed and code ECONNRESET; capture its initial stack.
Reject exactly one events insert/select/single query before HTTP. Do not replace the service implementation or store actions.
Wrap real eventsService.createEvent solely to capture its rejection and rethrow unchanged. sameCause must compare error.cause === originalError in the browser realm.
Return null until capture; serialize live original/cause names, messages, codes, and stacks with rejection count.
Restore both query patch and service observer idempotently, including after partial installation. The spec restores explicitly before real retry and again in finally.

fixture_needs.export: createEventTransportFailure(options?: { message?: string; code?: string }): TypeError & { code: string }

rationale: One P2 browser journey adds the missing service-to-store-to-dialog observation and real retry. Existing P1 unit matrix owns all write operations and fallback values; this scenario deliberately avoids duplicating that matrix.

selector_verification.observed: Anonymous Welcome Back sign-in page; no credential copying or mutations; own session closed.

unknowns: Parent must implement helper contract and then execute real Playwright validation; this worker generated JSON only and ran no tests.
Current Vite server was started with placeholder test key; parent will stop it so configured Playwright startup injects correct local keys.
No exported events response schema found. New retry/cleanup assertions cover fields under test; existing API suite retains full row schema coverage.
The helper must preserve actual service error identity: raw fetch abort alone would exercise upstream Supabase normalization instead of the DW-53 catch branch.
summary: Generated one P2 E2E create failure and deliberate retry scenario, with precise helper/factory requirements, original cause diagnostics, input/store/UI assertions, and cleanup scoped to the unique test label plus authenticated owner.
aggregation_changes: Require the successful retry created ID in cleanup DELETE representation
